_help: Hand-maintained per-repo overrides. Keys are repo names. Any field set here wins over what scripts/build-data.mjs derives. Supported: display_name, category, status, tags, notes, hidden, featured, source_channel, links (partial: live, demo, sales, docs). Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
